1.explanation:
1. src/js/components/Data/README.md—the core Data component orchestrates DataSearch, DataFilters, DataSort, etc. and is where the toolbar is composed.
2. src/js/components/Data/stories—contains the live examples (Filtering With Select, Filters In A Center Layer) that show when and how Clear Filters should render.
3. src/js/components/DataFilters/README.md—documents the DataFilters container that renders individual filters and the Clear Filters button.
4. src/js/components/DataFilters/stories—provides the story implementations of DataFilters, including the Clear Filters control behavior.
5. src/js/components/DataSearch/README.md—describes the search input component that, on change, should trigger the appearance of Clear Filters in the toolbar.
6. src/js/components/Toolbar/README.md—the generic Toolbar layout component used by Data to lay out controls; helps understand how a button gets promoted from embedded filters to the top level.
1.bug_scenario: The issue occurs in our Data listing pages (e.g. Servers, Hosts, Orders, etc.) that use the Grommet Data/DataToolbar components. When the user types in the DataSearch input or applies a filter via the filter icon, the “Clear Filters” button—which should automatically appear at the top level of the Data toolbar per the Filtering With Select and Filters In A Center Layer examples—is missing. Users can apply a search or filter, but there is no Clear Filters control exposed to reset those inputs.
